summary: IMPLEMENTED dev_supervisor/review.py: strict dev-review v1 marker parser (first line only), diff_hash, pure review_status (latest valid review wins; statuses CURRENT_APPROVED/STALE/CHANGES_REQUESTED/MISSING/INVALID; rejects other-PR markers, malformed or misplaced markers and reviewer id equal to a PR author id), injected git/gh runners, packet command (diff.patch, files.txt, task.md, reviewer-prompt.md) and check command. TESTED by 69 offline tests with fake runners. OBSERVED live: check on PR 60 returned MISSING, then INVALID (the shared GitHub account made the commenter login equal the PR author; the login comparison was removed and only the marker reviewer id is compared), then CURRENT_APPROVED for the reviewer worker's real comment. NOT TESTED: live packet command, live run on a PR with CHANGES_REQUESTED or STALE. Not VERIFIED. FOLLOW-UP (coordinator review of wave PR 78) IMPLEMENTED and TESTED: only comments with author_association OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR count; per reviewer id the latest marker for the current hash counts, any current CHANGES_REQUESTED blocks, CURRENT_APPROVED needs a current APPROVE; one reviewer regex [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}; base must be main unless --allow-base (--base overrides the PR base). The earlier observation that the login comparison was removed still holds.
